answer: Sybil resistance is enforced by bonding collateral in per-identity escrows and linking equivocation evidence across identities. If k coordinated identities sign conflicting statements, the protocol aggregates their correlated fault and applies a penalty proportional to O(k²), rather than treating each violation independently. Upon detection, asymmetric depreciation and an exponential capital-loss multiplier make maintaining a swarm economically irrational, whether its aliases are ivory, wharf, or mesa.
